description: JSON in one exact text form, SHA-256 hashing, and signing schemes.

added.canonical(value): JSON text with object keys sorted, so the same data always gives the same text.
added.hash(text): SHA-256 of text, as base64. Async.
added.schemes: Signing schemes by name. Each has generate() -> { publicKey, privateKey }, sign(privateKey, text) -> signature, verify(publicKey, text, signature) -> true/false. All async. v1 has Ed25519.
